description.value: A Vancouver landmark since 1988, Water St. Café occupies a restored 1906 heritage building—formerly the Edward Hotel—on the cobblestone streets of historic Gastown. It serves classic Italian cuisine with West Coast influence, an award-winning BC-focused wine list, and hosts nightly live music through its 2nd Floor Gastown venue. The restaurant is locally owned and independent, offering brunch, lunch, happy hour, and dinner in a relaxed heritage setting.
